step.title: Enter your sign-in code
step.description: We sent a 6 digit code to {destination}. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
step.descriptionNoDestination: We sent a 6 digit code to your email. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
step.resendIn: You can request another code in {seconds}s
step.resendInMinutes: You can request another code in {minutes}m
step.resendAlreadySent: A code is already on its way. Check your inbox.
step.backupHelp: One of the codes you saved when you turned on two-step sign-in. Each one works once.
step.attemptsLeft: {count} attempts left before you have to start again.
step.attemptsLeftOne: 1 attempt left before you have to start again.
step.genericError: That code is not valid. Request a new one and try again.
step.lockedOut: Too many wrong codes. Sign in again to get a new one.
step.spamNote: No code? Check your spam folder before requesting another.
step.deliveryFailed: We could not send the code just now. Try Send a new code, or use a recovery code below.
step.descriptionApp: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6 digit code it is showing for AFC.
step.appRefreshNote: The code changes every 30 seconds. If it is about to change, wait for the next one.
step.rememberDeviceHelp: We will stop asking for a code on this browser for 30 days. Leave it off on a shared or borrowed device.

security.title: Two-step sign-in
security.subtitle: Add a code to your sign in, so a stolen password is not enough to get into your account.
security.explainerBody: After you enter your password, AFC emails you a 6 digit code. You type that code to finish signing in. Anyone who steals your password still cannot get in without your email.
security.loadError: We could not load your security settings.
security.backupNone: No recovery codes left. Generate a new set now, before you need one.
security.backupLow: Only {count} left. Generate a new set so you do not get locked out.
security.backupExplainer: Recovery codes get you in if you lose access to your email. Each one works once.
security.regenerated: New recovery codes generated. The old ones no longer work.

enable.title: Turn on two-step sign-in
enable.step1Description: First we will email a code to {destination} to check it reaches you. Nothing changes until you enter it.
enable.step2Description: Enter the 6 digit code sent to {destination}.

disable.title: Turn off two-step sign-in
disable.warning: Your account will be protected by your password alone.
disable.step1Description: To confirm it is you, we will email a code to {destination}.
disable.step2Description: Enter the 6 digit code sent to {destination}, or use a recovery code.
disable.step1DescriptionApp: To confirm it is you, we will ask for a code from your authenticator app.
disable.step2DescriptionApp: Enter the 6 digit code your authenticator app is showing, or use a recovery code.

codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.description: These are shown once and never again. Save them somewhere you can reach without your email, like a password manager or a note on paper.

security.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
security.backupExplainerApp: Recovery codes get you in if you lose your phone or the app. Each one works once.

methods.title: How you get your code
methods.subtitle: Pick where your sign-in code comes from. You can change this later.
methods.emailBody: We send a 6 digit code to your email address. Works on any device, needs your inbox.
methods.appBody: Your phone makes the code itself, so it keeps working with no signal and no email.
methods.switchBackHint: To go back to email codes, turn two-step sign-in off, then turn it on again.

app.title: Set up your authenticator app
app.description: Two short steps. Nothing changes on your account until the last one.
app.step1Body: Open Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password or any app like them, and scan this square.
app.secretHelp: Use this if you cannot scan, for example when you are already on the phone your app is on.
app.step2Title: 2. Enter the code your app shows
app.step2Body: This proves the app really works before we switch anything on, so you cannot get locked out.
app.step3BodyEmail: We will send a code to {destination} as well, so nobody else can add their own app to your account.
app.step3BodyApp: Enter a code from the authenticator you are replacing, so nobody else can swap it for their own.
app.readyForProof: I have my current app open
app.proofSent: We sent a code to your email.

security.explainerBodyApp: After you enter your password, you open your authenticator app and type the 6 digit code it shows. Nothing is sent, so it works with no signal and even if your email is taken over.

prompt.title: Turn on two-step sign-in
prompt.body: Your account can approve payouts, edit events and see player data. A code on top of your password makes it much harder to take over.

profileCard.title: Sign-in security
profileCard.description: Turn on two-step sign-in and manage your recovery codes.

devices.title: Remembered devices
devices.subtitle: These browsers skip the code step for {days} days. Remove any you do not recognise.
devices.empty: Nothing is remembered yet. Tick "Remember this device" the next time you enter a code, and this browser will stop asking.

toast.revoked: That device will be asked for a code next time.
toast.revokedAll: Every device will be asked for a code next time.
toast.revokeFailed: We could not remove that device. Please try again.
toast.signOutFailed: We could not sign the other devices out. Please try again.

sessions.title: Signed in right now
sessions.subtitle: You are signed in somewhere else as well. If that was not you, sign it out.
sessions.onlyHere: This is the only place you are signed in.
sessions.explainer: Signing out ends a session straight away. It does not remove a remembered device, and removing a device does not sign it out.

confirm.oneDescription: That browser will be asked for a code the next time it signs in. It stays signed in for now.
confirm.allDescription: Every browser, including this one, will be asked for a code the next time it signs in.
confirm.signOutDescription: Every other browser is signed out straight away. You stay signed in here, and remembered devices are left alone.
